viewing_check: Ask to weigh it (grams is the main value driver) and check for a hallmark or 750 stamp inside the shank, since the lot only says acid tests as 18ct. Check each stone is present and real, any cracked or missing stones, ring size and wear to the bands. Photograph the inside of the shank.
